description: Retrospective per-series Ridge and naive-baseline metrics on publisher-declared Monash/M4 fixed-origin holdouts.

protocol.fit: Ridge uses only finite rows marked train within each series; imputation and scaling are fit on training features only.
protocol.baselines: Last observed value at the official origin and the training-target mean; MASE denominator is mean absolute one-step change in training targets (fallback 1 only for a constant series).
protocol.holdout: Publisher-declared forecast steps are scored individually and aggregated per series; no random split or horizon substitution is used.
protocol.time: TSF sequence indices are ordinal within-series positions, not verified event, publication, or label-availability times.
protocol.uncertainty: Per-series descriptive results only. The deterministic first-series subset is not treated as an IID sample of the full competition.

limitations: This diagnostic is retrospective and does not claim real-time label availability.
The direct Ridge model receives the same origin covariates at every horizon step; it is a baseline, not a tuned multi-step forecaster.
Only locally acquired deterministic subsets are evaluated; results are not full-dataset competition estimates.
